summary: Calls sub_559D80(this, a2) to look up a property; if the lookup succeeds, seeds the parse position from this[195] (the token pointer at this+0x30C) plus one, then parses up to four integers with CallWrapperWith0 (each call advancing the shared position through a2). Each parsed value is stored into the corresponding optional output pointer a3, a4, a5 or a6 only when that pointer is non-null. Returns 1 when the lookup succeeded, 0 when it failed. Called by sub_55A060, sub_55A500, SceneNode and SceneFileTopLevelParser.

local_names.a2: in/out parse position; seeded from this[195]+1 and advanced by each CallWrapperWith0 call
local_names.a3: optional output pointer for the first parsed integer
local_names.a4: optional output pointer for the second parsed integer
local_names.a5: optional output pointer for the third parsed integer
local_names.a6: optional output pointer for the fourth parsed integer
local_names.v7: success flag returned to the caller (1 on lookup success, 0 on lookup failure)

If the sub_559D80 lookup returns 0, skip parsing entirely and return 0 (failure)

Parse the first integer with CallWrapperWith0 from the current position, advance the shared position, and store the result into *a3 when a3 is non-null
Parse the second integer with CallWrapperWith0 from the current position, advance the shared position, and store the result into *a4 when a4 is non-null
Parse the third integer with CallWrapperWith0 from the current position, advance the shared position, and store the result into *a5 when a5 is non-null
Parse the fourth integer with CallWrapperWith0 from the current position and store the result into *a6 when a6 is non-null
Return the success flag v7 (1 if the lookup succeeded, 0 if it failed)
